content: For comprehensive information regarding this product and your specific health requirements, it is essential to consult your healthcare professional. In the United States, you should contact your doctor for medical advice concerning any side effects. Similarly, in Canada, you should reach out to your doctor for guidance on side effects. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. If the situation is less critical, contact a poison control center without delay. Residents of the United States can call the Poison Control Center at 1-800-222-1222. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Ensure proper disposal of this product when it has expired or is no longer needed. The information provided here was last updated in May 2024. It is important to note that this document serves as a summary and does not encompass all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your use. This information is not intended to replace personalized medical advice and should not substitute for the guidance of your healthcare provider. Always seek complete and individualized information about this product and your health needs from your healthcare professional.
